description.value: Pinnacle Lodge is a Westgate Resorts property in the mountain resort village of Sun Peaks, BC, positioned as a full-service accommodation base for exploring the surrounding ski and outdoor recreation area. Operated by Vacation Internationale under the Westgate brand, it offers hotel-style stays with attentive service in a purpose-built resort community. Sun Peaks is one of BC's larger ski resorts and sees significant summer trail activity, making this lodge a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the Thompson Okanagan highlands.
